description: Stage-aware parameters and stage configuration for Serverless Framework v4. https://www.serverless.com/framework/docs/guides/stages

ServerlessParamValue.description: A parameter value resolvable via ${param:key}. Strings, numbers, booleans and structured objects/arrays are all allowed.

ServerlessParams.title: ServerlessParams
ServerlessParams.description: Stage-aware parameters resolvable via ${param:key}. Reserve `default` for fallbacks; other keys are stage names. https://www.serverless.com/framework/docs/guides/parameters

observability.description: Enable Serverless Observability for this stage. Accepts a boolean or an object with provider-specific configuration.

ServerlessStages.title: ServerlessStages
ServerlessStages.description: Stage-keyed configuration. Reserve `default` for the fallback stage; other keys are stage names. Preferred over top-level `params` in v4. https://www.serverless.com/framework/docs/guides/stages
